findings.detail: X02 is applied to unfunded commitment rows whose source intentionally has no interest term or rate; funded debt rows remain rate-bearing.

rationale: The source schedule distinguishes funded delayed-draw debt from unfunded commitment lines. The funded MB2 Dental row at table 16 row 5 reports S + 550 and 9.17%, while the adjacent (4)(5) commitment row at table 16 row 6 has no interest term or rate, dash principal, and parenthesized cost/fair value. The missing rate is therefore faithful to the filing; X02 is over-broad when it treats these commitment rows as ordinary rate-bearing PRIVATE_CREDIT positions.
